extensionDescription.message: Organize, search and export your ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, AI Studio and Grok chats. Free, local, no account.

popup_no_site.message: Open a chat on a supported AI site to use Artifact here.

popup_not_loaded.message: Artifact isn't running on this tab yet. Reload the page.

popup_no_chat.message: No messages found on this page.

menu_export_markdown.message: Artifact: export this chat as Markdown

warning_text.message: This chat is $PERCENT$% full (≈ $LEFT$ exchanges left). Quality drops as it fills.

warning_text_red.message: This chat is $PERCENT$% full (≈ $LEFT$ exchanges left). Consider continuing in a new chat.

dash_caps_empty.message: Add the message caps of your plan to see how many you have left. Artifact counts your sends on this device.

dash_caps_hint.message: Enter a model as it appears in the model picker, or * for all models, with the number of messages your plan allows per window.

dash_heatmap_label.message: Messages sent by weekday and hour

dash_no_site.message: No AI site in this tab

export_done_partial.message: Saved $NAME$. $COUNT$ files could not be downloaded; see MISSING_FILES.txt in the ZIP.

export_files_note.message: This chat has $FILES$ files and $ARTIFACTS$ artifacts. When included, the export is a ZIP with the real files.

export_shift_hint.message: Click to select messages; Shift-click selects a range. With none selected, the whole branch is exported.

preview_missing.message: This preview has expired. Open it again from Artifact.

settings_feature_warnings.message: Warnings when a chat fills up

settings_limit_hint.message: Use a model id as the site reports it, or site:<name> for a whole site. Your number replaces the published one.

settings_obsidian_hint.message: The exact name of your vault, as shown in Obsidian.

settings_plans_hint.message: Context limits depend on your plan. Artifact detects it where the site exposes it; otherwise pick it here.

settings_sites_hint.message: Artifact runs only on the sites you turn on.

command_preview.message: Open this chat in a preview tab

folder_delete_confirm.message: Delete “$NAME$”? Its chats and subfolders move up one level.

folder_drop_root.message: Drop a folder here to make it top-level

folder_drop_unknown.message: That link isn't a chat on a supported site.

folders_empty.message: No folders yet. Folders can hold chats from every site.

folders_empty_sidebar.message: Drag a chat here after creating a folder with +.

folders_folder_empty.message: This folder is empty. Drag chats onto it, or select chats and use Add to folder.

folders_none.message: No chats here yet. Chats you open are stored automatically; a deep scan in Search stores the rest.

import_hint.message: Makes a folder for each project, under one folder for this site, and files the stored chats that belong to it. Running it again only adds what's new.

import_none.message: This site has no projects on this account.

index_empty.message: Nothing stored yet. Open a chat or run a deep scan.

library_bookmarks_empty.message: No bookmarks. Hover a message on any site and use the bookmark button in its margin.

library_highlights_empty.message: No highlights. Select text in a reply and pick a color.

library_notes_empty.message: No notes. Write one for the open chat on the Dashboard.

library_reminders_empty.message: No reminders. Set one for the open chat on the Dashboard.

library_tag_delete_confirm.message: Remove the tag “$NAME$” from every chat?

reminder_default.message: You asked to come back to this chat.

reminder_future.message: Pick a time in the future.

rules_hint.message: Rules tag chats by keywords, on this device only. Built-in rules need two matching words in the text, or one in the title.

scan_already.message: A scan is already running in that tab.

scan_hint.message: Reads your full chat list and stores every chat that is new or changed. It pauses while you type or a reply is streaming, and picks up where it stopped. Keep this tab open while it runs.

scan_need_site.message: Open a supported site in this tab to scan its history.

settings_feature_library.message: Store and index chats I open

settings_feature_library_hint.message: Kept in this browser only. Needed for search, folders and the library.

settings_feature_tools.message: Bookmark and label buttons beside messages

this_chat_not_stored.message: Not stored yet; it will be once the chat finishes loading.

autocontinue_limit.message: Stopped continuing after $N$ times in a row.

branches_hint.message: Every edit and regeneration in this chat. Messages on the version shown on the page jump to it; others open here. Tick two replies to compare them.

branches_pick_second.message: Tick one more reply to compare.

broadcast_autosend_hint.message: Off: the prompt waits in each composer for you to send. On: it is sent as soon as each page is ready.

broadcast_hint.message: Opens a new chat on each site with this prompt in the composer, and a page that shows the replies side by side.

chains_hint.message: A chain sends its steps one after another in the open chat, each when the previous reply has finished. Type .. in the composer to start one there.

chains_paste_hint.message: Separate steps with a line containing only ---

collapse_collapsed_all.message: All messages collapsed. Alt+Shift+E expands them.

compare_missing.message: This comparison has expired. Start a new broadcast from the side panel.

composer_not_found.message: Couldn't find the message box on this page.

enhance_empty.message: Type a prompt first, then enhance it.

enhance_send_hint.message: Send this message; when the reply arrives you can review the rewritten prompt.

files_hint.message: Files here can be attached automatically whenever a prompt that uses them is inserted. They are kept in this browser only.

fill_failed.message: The text couldn't be placed in the message box. Copy it and paste it yourself.

handoff_ask.message: Ask this chat for a summary

handoff_asking.message: Putting the request in the composer…

handoff_autosend.message: Send automatically in the new chat

handoff_autosend_hint.message: Off: the summary waits in the new chat's composer for you to read and send.

handoff_chat_hint.message: Puts a request in this chat's composer for the assistant to write the handoff. Send it, wait for the reply, then use the reply as the summary.

handoff_chat_sent.message: Request placed in the composer. Send it, then use the reply.

handoff_hint.message: Starts a new chat, on this site or another, that picks up where this one is. The current chat is not changed.

handoff_local_hint.message: Built here from the chat: the goal, constraints, decisions, recent code and the latest exchanges, cut to the budget.

handoff_need_chat.message: Open a chat on a supported site to carry it forward.

handoff_no_reply.message: There is no reply to use yet.

handoff_still_streaming.message: The reply is still coming in.

history_hint.message: Prompts you sent, newest first. In an empty message box, the Up and Down keys bring them back.

keepalive_offline.message: You're offline. Your draft is saved.

keepalive_session.message: The site says your session expired. Your draft is saved; reload to sign back in and it will be restored.

mention_not_stored.message: That chat isn't stored yet. Open it once, or run a deep scan, then mention it.

picker_no_chains.message: No chains yet. Create them in the side panel's Prompts tab.

picker_no_prompts.message: No saved prompts yet. Add them in the side panel's Prompts tab.

prompts_autosend_hint.message: Off by default. When on, inserting this prompt also sends it.

prompts_empty.message: No prompts yet. Create one, import a file, or add the starter prompts below.

prompts_need_site.message: Open a chat on a supported site in this tab first.

prompts_starter_source.message: Starter prompts are from a public-domain collection:

queue_added.message: Queued. It will be sent when the current reply finishes.

queue_hint.message: Prompts to send one after another in the open chat, each when the previous reply finishes. In the message box, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Enter adds to the queue too.

settings_autocontinue_hint.message: Clicks the site's Continue button when a reply stops early. Off by default.

settings_collapse_hint.message: A button beside each message, and Alt+Shift+E for all.

settings_counter.message: Word and character count under the composer

settings_enhancer_hint.message: Each preset is an instruction the enhancer puts above your prompt. Pick one from the enhance button.

settings_finish.message: Alert when a long reply finishes in another tab

settings_finish_hint.message: A desktop notification, and a short chime if you like.

settings_formula.message: Double-click a formula to copy its LaTeX

settings_history.message: Prompt history with Up and Down

settings_keepalive.message: Watch for lost connections and expired sessions

settings_keepalive_hint.message: Shows a notice and keeps your draft so a reload loses nothing.

settings_profile_hint.message: Insert this into any new chat with the person button above the composer.

settings_prompt_target.message: Right-click prompts on other pages open

settings_queue_key_hint.message: It is sent after the current reply finishes.

settings_speed_hint.message: The browser skips drawing messages far off screen.

settings_timeline.message: Timeline rail at the right edge

settings_triggers_hint.message: Typed in the site's message box.

syntax_builtin.message: Filled in for you: today's date, the time, or the selected text

syntax_choice.message: Pick one; * marks the default and ... adds an Other box

syntax_const.message: A fixed value used elsewhere as {{lang}}; never asked

syntax_default.message: A text field with a default and a hint

syntax_file.message: Ask for a file to attach

syntax_hidden.message: Asked, but printed only where {{audience}} appears

syntax_text.message: A text field, asked once, used everywhere it appears

var_hidden.message: Not printed here; used where the prompt refers to it.

autoarchive_hint.message: Rules never archive on their own. Once a day Artifact counts the chats that match and notifies you; you review the list and start it. Archiving is available on: $SITES$.

autoarchive_note_message.message: $N$ chats match your auto-archive rules. Click to review.

backup_denied.message: Permission to write to the folder was not given.

backup_due_message.message: Click to write new and changed chats to your backup folder.

backup_everything_hint.message: One Artifact archive with every stored chat, your folders, tags, notes, prompts and settings. Restore it with Deep Import on another computer.

backup_folder_note.message: The browser may ask again before writing; a scheduled backup to a folder shows a notification you click.

backup_hint.message: Writes each new or changed chat as Markdown and as an Artifact archive, plus your library. A folder synced by Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox doubles as sync.

data_actions_hint.message: Opens a page with the full list first. Above 10 chats you type a confirmation. It runs one chat at a time, can pause or stop, and keeps a log you can download.

data_export_hint.message: One ZIP, with files and artifacts for each chat. Stored copies are used when up to date; others are read from the site in a background tab.

data_include_json.message: Also save JSON for each chat

data_include_json_hint.message: Lets Deep Import restore these chats later.

data_none.message: No stored chats in that selection.

data_pdf_note.message: PDF and PNG are made one chat at a time from the Export tab; for many chats, HTML prints to PDF from any browser.

import_deep_hint.message: Reads the official export from ChatGPT (conversations.json), Claude (conversations.json) or Google Takeout (My Activity › Gemini Apps, as JSON), and Artifact archives and backups. Nothing is written until you confirm.

import_gemini_note.message: Google Takeout keeps Gemini activity as separate prompts, not whole chats, so each one is imported as a single exchange. Replies are included when the file has them.

import_to_folder.message: Put imported chats in a new folder

import_with_library.message: Restore folders, tags, notes, prompts and settings too

import_with_library_hint.message: Items with the same id are replaced.

settings_sites_tier2_hint.message: Export, copy, prompt insertion, search and bookmarks from the page itself. The browser asks for access to each site when you switch it on.

tasks_action_unsupported.message: $N$ of these are on sites where this isn't available and will be skipped. Available on: $SITES$.

tasks_action_warning_archive.message: This archives $N$ chats on the site itself.

tasks_action_warning_delete.message: This deletes $N$ chats on the site itself. It can't be undone there.

tasks_action_warning_unarchive.message: This unarchives $N$ chats on the site itself.

tasks_delete_library_keep.message: Artifact keeps its stored copy of each deleted chat.

tasks_delete_library_remove.message: Artifact's stored copy is removed too.

tasks_export_hint.message: Keep this page open while it runs. Stopping keeps everything finished so far, with a report of what's missing.

tasks_export_stopped.message: Stopped after $OK$ of $TOTAL$ chats. The ZIP has everything finished so far.

tasks_missing.message: This job has expired. Start it again from the side panel.

vault_artifacts_empty.message: No artifacts or canvases in stored chats yet.

vault_hint.message: Every artifact, image and code block across your stored chats.

vault_media_empty.message: No images in stored chats yet.

vault_media_failed.message: $N$ images couldn't be loaded from their sites.

vault_media_hint.message: Images are loaded from each site with your session, so the site must be signed in. Previews load for up to 60 at a time.

vault_mermaid_firefox.message: Firefox can't run the sandboxed renderer, so the diagram source is shown.

vault_snippets_empty.message: No code blocks in stored chats yet.
